newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Dutch KLM adds fifth weekly flight on Kiev route.
newsitem.headline: Dutch KLM adds fifth weekly flight on Kiev route.

text.p: Dutch national carrier KLM Royal Airlines will start flying to Kiev from Amsterdam on Mondays from next week, taking the number of its direct flights on the route to five a week, an airline spokeswoman said on Thursday.
"We will innaugurate our fifth weekly flight on the Amsterdam-Kiev route on July 28," she said.
She said all flights have been made with Boeing 737 planes, adding the average load factor before the expansion was 80 per cent in economy class and 70 per cent in business one.
So far KLM has been flying to Kiev on Tuesdays, Thursdays, Saturdays, Sundays.
Ukrainian International Airlines (UIA), the former Soviet republic's second carrier, flies to Amsterdam three times per week on Mondays, Wednesdays and Fridays.
